# orbstack_machines (Data Source)

List OrbStack machines.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orbstack_machines" "running" {
  running = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `running` (Boolean) When true, list only running machines.

### Read-Only

- `machines` (Attributes List) Machines reported by orbctl list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines))

<a id="nestedatt--machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String) Machine architecture.
- `distro` (String) Distribution reported by orbctl.
- `id` (String) Machine ULID.
- `name` (String) Machine name.
- `state` (String) State reported by orbctl.
- `version` (String) Distribution version reported by orbctl.
